subscription.basis: AEOS counts only the calls made through this AEOS instance; usage of the same provider workspace from other clients or machines is invisible to it, so the provider's own limit (blocked requests; HTTP 429 per OpenCode's client test fixture, NOT-PROVEN) stays authoritative. Allowance per request: provider usage.opencode.allowance (REPORTED), else tokens x the route's allowance rates or a token upper bound x the highest rate (ESTIMATED, rounded up). The trailing 5h window blocks admission; the week (7 days) and month (31 days) windows are advisory (WARN_EXHAUSTED): the provider's reset anchors are unknown and with Extra Usage OFF exceeding them only yields provider refusals.
